description: This file is a header file defining interfaces for board-specific functions in an embedded system, such as memory retrieval, system information, panic handling, and character output.

methods.name: board_get_memory
methods.description: Retrieves the amount of memory available on the board.

methods.name: board_get_system
methods.description: Populates the provided buffer with system information, up to the specified length.

methods.name: board_panic
methods.description: Handles panic situations, likely by halting or resetting the system.

methods.name: board_putchar
methods.description: Outputs a character to the board's output interface, possibly for debugging or logging.
